title: Rocker-and-Go Attack
description: From a live dribble, the ball handler rocks the shoulders back as if to stop, then explodes forward, using a body fake rather than a hand change.

content.objective: Use a shoulder rocker on the dribble to freeze a defender's feet and win the first step.
content.setup: Offense at the left wing with a ball, a defender in front.
instructions: Dribble slowly toward the defender with the outside hand.
Rock the shoulders back and lift the eyes as if pulling up for a shot.
As the defender rises or steps up, push the ball forward and explode past.
If the defender does not react, repeat the rocker once more before attacking.
coachingPoints: The ball stays in the same hand: only the body fakes.
Sell it with the eyes on the rim.
Explode on the defender's movement, not on a count.
commonMistakes: Rocker without any change of speed.
content.safety: Defenders play legal, chest-up defense; no reaching across the body.
progressions: Rocker into a pull-up when the defender backs off.
Add a help defender at the block.
regressions: Defender reacts on purpose to teach timing.
Walk the rocker without a defender.
variations: Rocker from the top of the key.
Two rockers in a row before attacking.
successCriteria: Wins the first step past the defender in 6 of 10 attempts.
Dribble stays alive through every rocker.
content.gameApplication: The rocker uses the threat of the shot to open the drive; it works best for players who can score from range.
